info.name: fundi-api
info.description: Postman requests for Fundi API. For job-owner requests, a customer or technician may use their access token. Public technician registration can create a user/profile; signed-in customers can also become technicians through profile completion. Uploads use form-data; admin authentication uses cookies.

item.name: Preview matches from geocoded place names

request.description: Geocodes up to five place names using the configured provider and returns distance-aware matches. Nominatim is the default provider.

item.name: Preview matches by technician location text

request.description: Matches by stored technician address/location labels, optional latitude/longitude coordinates, or both. Text matching includes technicians without coordinates; coordinate matches include distance.
Save response.id as paymentId. The amount is loaded from the category bookingFee and is valid for seven days.
Development/test only. Does not verify money with a provider and is disabled in production. Save response.id as paymentId.

item.name: Request phone OTP for this job

request.description: No body. Save verificationId from the response; a fresh verification is required per job.

item.name: Verify phone OTP for this job

request.description: Use Body > form-data. First complete mock payment and job phone OTP verification. Add paymentId, phoneVerificationId, serviceCategoryId, description, locationAddress, latitude, longitude, offeredAmount, and optional priority as text fields. Use photos (up to five) and video (one) as optional File fields.

formdata.value: Repair a leaking kitchen tap and check the connection.

item.name: Booking Payments
item.description: Development-only mock category booking payments. These endpoints do not transfer real money.

request.description: Requires an admin session cookie retained by Postman, or an admin bearer token.
Lists payments whose payment and associated job statuses are both COMPLETED.
Requires a completed job that does not already have a payment. Amount/customer are derived from that job.
Update the external reference, phone, and/or paid timestamp.
Deletes the payment record while preserving a full audit snapshot.
days must be from 1 to 30. Completed payments cannot be extended.
Technician confirms agreement to work with the job owner. The booking payment expires when the customer also confirms.
